name: Midjourney
bestFor: Art-directed stills when style matters more than Photoshop round-trip
skipIf: You need commercially safe Adobe-stack files or a free generator
keyFeatures: Web studio and prompt style references
Consistent visual taste for concept decks
limitations: Outputs flat images rather than layered PSDs
summary: Still the taste leader for many illustrators. Paid-only. Discord-era habits linger.
body: Midjourney remains the look people mean by “AI art” in client decks. There is no meaningful free plan, which is honest. Firefly wins when Legal asks about training data and Creative Cloud. Flux and Ideogram win on some typography and photoreal niches. If a site offers “Midjourney premium free,” it is malware. Plans checked 18 Sep 2026.
notes: Read the current commercial terms for client work
Keep a prompt log; the UI is not your DAM
Not a video tool, even if the company experiments
